text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘How Mangoes Grow’ (आम कैसे उगता है)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘How Mangoes Grow’ (Aam kaise ugta hai). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘How Mangoes Grow’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘seed’ मतलब बीज। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘seed’ matlab beej. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘seed’ means बीज. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘soil’ मतलब मिट्टी। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘soil’ matlab mitti. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘soil’ means मिट्टी. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘sunlight’ मतलब धूप। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘sunlight’ matlab dhoop. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘sunlight’ means धूप. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: A mango tree starts from a seed.
The seed is planted in the soil.
After some weeks, a small plant comes out.
It needs sunlight and water to grow.
In five or six years, the tree is big enough to give fruit.
In spring, small flowers grow on the tree.
The flowers slowly turn into tiny green mangoes.
By summer, the mangoes become big, yellow and sweet.

question.hi: आम का पेड़ किससे शुरू होता है?
question.hinglish: Aam ka ped kisse shuru hota hai?
question.en: What does a mango tree start from?
What do the flowers turn into?
